subject: ela
intro: Good writers write often, both quick pieces (like a journal entry in a few minutes) and longer pieces (like a report over several days). Writing a lot builds skill. Third graders understand which tasks are short and which take more time, and that practice helps.

items.prompt: Which takes a LONGER time to write: a quick journal sentence or a full research report?

steps: A research report has many parts and sources.
So the research report takes longer.

items.prompt: Which is a SHORT writing task: a one-page book report over a week, or a quick note to a friend?

steps: A quick note is written fast.
So the quick note is the short task.
solution.answer: A quick note to a friend.

items.prompt: Writing often helps you become a ____ writer.

steps: So you become a better writer.

items.prompt: A quick journal entry takes a ____ time.
A big report over many days takes a ____ time.
